documentation.scope: This profile folder only; the workspace Antwork PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md remain separate.
documentation.nativeStyling: GitHub owns the page background and native prose typography.
documentation.tonalRamps: Metadata shows eight existing grayscale palette values; it adds no production colors.
documentation.provenance: All production art is generated text SVG. Preview PNGs are browser captures excluded from publication.
documentation.captureLimit: 1440px desktop and 390px mobile captures use GitHub Markdown API HTML with approximate default dark GitHub CSS; they are not published-profile captures.
documentation.seed: None; the precise brief pins OLED black and ASCII.
documentation.sampleLimit: Static artwork excerpts for the design panel; the activity sample shows only the existing legend, never invented contribution data.

narrative.overview:
Authored ASCII establishes Rad's identity; native GitHub headings, paragraphs, and links make his introduction and project easy to read. The finished system is monochrome, flat, and spacious around dense character art.

The brief precisely specified OLED black and ASCII. No random concept seed was used. This document describes the profile folder; Antwork's application design system remains separate.
keyCharacteristics: Pure-black SVG panels with grayscale ink.
Real monospace characters for RAD, the orbital field, and the ant.
Native prose and links between responsive graphic panels.

rules.name: The Host Boundary Rule
rules.body: Pure black belongs to the SVG artwork. GitHub controls the page background, native text, heading rules, and link styling.

dos: Do regenerate SVGs from their included scripts and keep meaningful image alt text.
Do preserve the native content order and the author's casual voice.
Do keep the 600px picture switch and label the shorter mobile calendar.
donts: Don't add colored badges or unrelated statistics.
Don't treat preview captures or the dark preview shell as production profile styling.
Don't replace contribution data with placeholders or hand-drawn counts.
